role_extensions.falling_accent: isolated falling leaf/fruit/petal marks, each surrounded by paper, placed near or under the crown they fell from
role_extensions.underside_view: the lower edge of a crown/branch seen from below: hanging scallops or kana hooks that close the leaf mass over the trunk or branch
